description: WABetaInfo reports that WhatsApp is introducing a new registration experience for tablets across iPad and Android. The iPad version reportedly supports direct account registration with passkey authentication, while Android tablets are testing a simplified setup screen for choosing between companion mode and primary device registration. The changes are expected to remove several limitations associated with linked devices, although the Android implementation remains limited to selected beta testers for now.
title: WhatsApp Rolls Out Primary Device Support on iPad, Tests New Setup Screen for Android Tablets: Report

description: OnePlus Ace 7 series is said to be in the works. This time, the company is tipped to launch vanilla OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro models. They are said to come with a 6.78-inch flat display with 1.5K resolution and 185Hz refresh rate. They are tipped to feature a 9,000mAh battery with support for either 100W or 120W fast charging. The duo could include active fan cooling and is said to feature a minimalist build.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Series Tipped to Feature 185Hz Display, 9,000mAh Battery

description: Maharashtra has become the first Indian state to explicitly include cryptocurrencies and other virtual digital assets under its depositor protection law. The amendment allows authorities to trace, attach, value, and liquidate digital assets linked to fraudulent investment schemes. While the move does not legalise cryptocurrencies or introduce a licensing regime, it strengthens the state’s ability to recover losses suffered by victims of financial fraud involving digital assets.
title: Maharashtra Legislature Passes Amendment to Bring Virtual Digital Assets Under Depositor Protection Law

description: Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026 commences at midnight today for everyone. However, the early deals are already live, giving you a head start. Additionally, if you are a Prime member, you can get early access to the sale event now. Whether you want to buy your first smartphone or upgrade your current one, the Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026 will let you maximise your savings. If you have a Rs. 50,000 budget, there are plenty of options available. Handsets that were launched at a higher price can now be purchased within this particular price bracket. For reference, the OnePlus 13, which features a triple rear camera unit, will be available at a discounted price of Rs. 49,999, instead of its listed price of Rs. 72,999.
title: Amazon Prime Day Mobile Offers 2026: Best Deals on OnePlus, Nothing and More

description: Samsung is reportedly evaluating larger batteries for the Galaxy S27 Ultra after previously planning a 5,200mAh unit. A new leak suggests the company is testing 5,600mAh and 5,800mAh cells from Samsung SDI, with the final device potentially featuring a battery exceeding 5,500mAh. The report also claims Samsung will continue using lithium-ion technology instead of silicon-carbon batteries. If the leak proves accurate, the Galaxy S27 Ultra could offer a larger battery than the rumoured iPhone 18 Pro Max.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Battery Details Leaked; Could Top iPhone 18 Pro Max's Battery Capacity

description: Nokia 235 4G (2026), Nokia 215 4G (2026), Nokia 210 4G, and Nokia 200 4G feature phones have been launched in select global markets. They have 4G connectivity and run on the S30+ operating system. They feature a 1,450mAh battery and expandable storage up to 32GB. All four models feature an AI assistant button for accessing different features with voice commands.
title: Nokia 235 4G (2026), 215 4G (2026) Launched Alongside Nokia 210 4G, and 200 4G With AI Assistant Button

description: Nothing Phone 1, the first smartphone from Carl Pei-led tech firm, is now receiving its last OS major OS update, the company announced on Thursday. The update brings Android 15 to the handset, along with “general improvements and bug fixes” and the latest security patch. With this, the smartphone has completed its software lifecycle, during which it received three major OS upgrades and security updates for four years. The handset was launched in India in July 2022. The handset shipped with the Android 12-based Nothing OS 1 version.
title: Nothing Phone 1 Receives Final Software Update With Latest Security Patches, Bug Fixes and Improvements

description: Cyberpunk 2077 has now sold 40 million copies, developer CD Projekt Red has confirmed. The game has reached the sales milestone in less than six years of launch. The sales figure includes copies of Cyberpunk 2077 sold separately and in the Ultimate edition bundle, which includes the Phantom Liberty expansion.
title: Cyberpunk 2077 Has Sold 40 Million Copies, CD Projekt Red Confirms

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 series, which is expected to be launched early next year, will include the Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27+, Galaxy S27 Pro, and Galaxy S27 Ultra models, as per recent leaks. Now, a report, citing industry sources, claims that the company will equip all the Galaxy S27 series phones with the Privacy Display feature, as found on this year's flagship Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra. On top of this, the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will reportedly launch with an upgraded 16-megapixel selfie camera.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27+ Said to Feature 'Privacy Display'; Ultra Model Might Get Selfie Camera Upgrade

description: Sony announced it was ending physical game disc production for all new PlayStation games starting January 2028. Now, the company has reportedly begun restructuring its biggest disc making facility in Austria. The plans, which makes 600,000 discs a day, will reportedly shift to producing optical microlenses.
title: Sony Reportedly Restructures Disc Factory After Announcing End of Physical Game Discs on PlayStation

description: Redmi 17 5G could launch soon. While Redmi has yet to officially confirm its arrival, its appearance across multiple certification platforms suggests that an official launch may not be far away. The upcoming phone was reportedly spotted on Malaysia's Standard and Industrial Research Institute (SIRIM) certification website and Taiwan's National Communications Commission (NCC) certification database with the 26062RN92G model number.
title: Redmi 17 5G NCC, SIRIM Certification Listings Reportedly Reveal Battery and Charging Details

description: The government has asked "app stores" to take down two apps that were being used to play "pranks", where people were remotely shutting down e-rickshaws from their smartphones, the Secretary of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), S. Krishnan, told ANI. The bureaucrat also said that both apps have since been taken down by the app storage. While the official claims that the two apps have been taken down in accordance with the government’s direction, Gadgets 360 staff members found that one of the two apps is still listed on Apple’s App Store and the Google Play Store.
title: Government Directs App Stores to Remove Malicious Apps Used to Disrupt E-Rickshaw Operations: Report

description: Apple is widely expected to unveil the iPhone 18 lineup in September. In recent months, rumours have suggested that the Cupertino-based tech giant will introduce the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra — its first foldable iPhone. Ahead of the anticipated launch, a fresh leak has shed light on one of the key internal components of the iPhone 18 Pro. According to a report, the purported handset could use different modem chips for the US and international markets.
title: iPhone 18 Pro to Feature Apple's C2 Modem Globally, Qualcomm Chip in the US: Report

description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro Max is tipped to feature a larger battery than its predecessor, with the eSIM version reportedly packing a 5,425mAh cell and the physical SIM model a 5,235mAh battery. A previous leak also points to modest battery upgrades for the iPhone 18 Pro. The handset is expected to use Apple's rumoured A20 Pro chip built on a 2nm process. Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 series in September 2026.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Might Arrive With Apple's Biggest Smartphone Battery to Date, Latest Leak Suggests

description: Lenovo announced that the launch of Lenovo Legion Y700 AI will take place in August this year. The new gaming-focused tablet is confirmed to offer 5G connectivity and a compact build. It will come with AI-based features. The teaser video shared by Lenovo shows the Legion Y700 AI in a purple colourway with Legion branding on the back panel. It will have a 50-megapixel rear camera unit.
title: Lenovo Legion Y700 AI Tablet Confirmed to Launch in August; Company Teases Gaming Tablet's Design

description: Bitcoin traded above $61,500 on Friday after softer-than-expected US jobs data improved investor sentiment and reduced expectations of an immediate Federal Reserve rate hike. Major altcoins also advanced, while provisional inflows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs signalled improving institutional participation. Analysts, however, cautioned that rising exchange deposits and thin market liquidity could trigger fresh volatility despite the market’s recovery.
title: Bitcoin Climbs Above $61,600 as Weak US Jobs Data Boosts Crypto Investor Sentiment

description: iQOO Z11i has been launched in China. The new mid-range smartphone is currently on sale in the country via the Vivo China online store. The iQOO Z11i is offered in three colour options, namely, Desert Gold, Mo Ying, and Qingfeng (translated from Chinese). An octa core Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset powers the new handset, along with up to 8GB of RAM and up to 256GB of storage. It also gets a single 13-megapixel camera on the back, along with a 5-megapixel selfie shooter on the front, housed inside a water drop-style notch.

description: Homegrown consumer electronics and wearables brand Fire-Boltt recently announced its foray into India's smartphone market. The company has confirmed plans to launch new smartphones under a new brand called Boltt. While official specifications remain under wraps, a new leak has now revealed the possible moniker of its first handset. It has also been sighted on a benchmarking site, with some of its key specifications listed. The purported phone is said to be powered by a UniSoc chipset and feature 4GB of RAM.
title: Fire-Boltt's First Smartphone May Be Called Boltt Evo 4G, Tipster Claims; Key Specifications Leak

description: Sony announced this week that it would end production of physical game discs on PlayStation consoles from January 2028. It seems Xbox is taking the digital route, as well. According to a report, the company is testing a new disc-to-digital feature that will allow Xbox users to digitise their physical game collections.
title: Xbox Will Reportedly Allow Users to Digitise Physical Games, Ship Project Helix Without Disc Drive

description: DJI's Mic Mini 2S combines onboard recording, multi-device compatibility and long battery life in a compact wireless microphone system. It supports up to four transmitters with a single receiver, while AI-powered audio processing includes two noise reduction modes and three voice presets. The transmitter can also connect directly to select Osmo cameras or smartphones over Bluetooth. Other features include fast file transfers, up to 400m wireless transmission and a charging case rated to deliver up to 40 hours of use.
title: DJI Mic Mini 2S Launched With 32-Bit Float Recording, AI Noise Cancellation: Price, Features

description: If you’re a PC gamer, then having a dedicated gaming monitor can make a big difference to your experience. While a high-end CPU and a powerful GPU deliver high frame rates, a monitor with a high refresh rate, low response time, and adaptive sync technologies ensures those frames are displayed smoothly without tearing or stuttering. If you've been planning to upgrade your gaming setup, Amazon Prime Day 2026 brings several deals on gaming monitors from Acer, Samsung, LG, Lenovo Legion, BenQ, and Zebronics.
title: Amazon Prime Day Gaming Monitor Deals: Best Offers on LG, Samsung, and Zebronics Monitors

description: Project Neo is Lumio's ambitious attempt to bridge the gap between discovering content on your phone and watching it on your TV. It is a smart and practical software implementation that is genuinely relevant to how modern users want to interact with their TVs, letting you interact through the messaging interfaces you already use all day long.
title: Lumio Project Neo First Look: This Genius Feature Ends the Frustration of Cross-Device Streaming

description: Samsung will reportedly drop its Exynos chipset from the Galaxy A18 lineup. The 4G variant of the phone is said to use a MediaTek processor, while the Galaxy A18 5G could feature a Qualcomm Snapdragon chipset.  The 4G variant of the Galaxy A17, for comparison, has a MediaTek Helio G99 chipset, while the 5G model is equipped with Samsung's own Exynos 1330 SoC. The 4G-supported model is said to go official first, followed by the 5G model months later.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 Models Said to Drop Exynos Chip in Favour of MediaTek, Snapdragon

title: Huawei Band 11 Series Launched in India With 1.62-Inch Display, Over 100 Workout Modes: Price, Features
